_meta.description: LabVIEW connector-pane pattern geometry, keyed by conId (the pattern number stored in the FPHb <conPane><conId>). Encodes, per pattern, the cell grid and which terminal INDEX occupies each cell — the data a faithful connector-pane renderer/diff needs, since LabVIEW does NOT persist the per-cell grid in the VI (only the conId; the grid is recomputed at draw time).
_meta.index_convention: A terminal's index is its LabVIEW connector-pane SLOT index (the same index ParsedConnectorPaneSlot.index / VI-scripting ConnectorPane.Controls[] use). The index ORIGIN AND DIRECTION DIFFER PER PATTERN — there is no universal rule. 4815/4810/4812/... number Right->Left, Bottom->Top (idx0 = bottom-right); 4820/4834/... number from the top-left; 4833 uses a border interleave. Each pattern's index->cell map below is read verbatim from the authoritative pattern image, never extrapolated from a rule.

layout_forms.columns: columns[c] is the list of terminal indices in visual column c (left->right), ordered TOP->BOTTOM. Every column is drawn equal-width (1/ncols); a column's cells split ITS height equally (a column with fewer cells => taller, vertically-centered cells). Reproduces the outer-tall / inner-short look of e.g. 4-2-2-4.
layout_forms.grid: For irregular patterns whose cells span columns (merged wide cells). grid={cols,rows}; cells=[{index,col,row,colspan,rowspan}] in integer grid units, col/row 0-based from the top-left.

_meta.in_out_note: This file is PURE GEOMETRY. Whether a given terminal is an input or an output is NOT a property of the pattern — it comes from the VI's own slots (ParsedConnectorPaneSlot.is_output). The renderer colors/labels each cell from the VI's actual terminal; the pattern only says where the cell is.
_meta.provenance: Cell grids + per-cell indices read from the LabVIEW Wiki public connector-pane pattern images (labviewwiki.org 'File:Connector_Pane_Pattern_<conId>.png', 128x128, clean-room source #2 — public web docs, NOT LabVIEW). conId population + corpus_files counts measured across 4569 extracted FPHb files in the local corpus. 4815 additionally cross-checked against the corpus-geometry-derived mapping in reference_connector_pane_terminal_index.
_meta.coverage: Encodes the 13 conIds covering ~98.75% of the corpus (4512/4569 FPHb). Rarer conIds (4829, 4835, 4825, 4826, 4814, 4832, 4831, 4819, 4817, 4809, 4813, 4818) are not yet encoded; a consumer should fall back gracefully for an unknown conId.
